designationHistory.designation: part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area
designationHistory.indexText: Congress established Golden Gate National Recreation Area, and Alcatraz Island came under the National Park Service as part of it.
designationHistory.note: The act does not name Alcatraz in its text; the island is included through the boundary map and the transfer of federal property within the boundary (sec. 3(a)). The 1976 NPS brochure says the bill included Alcatraz as a unit.
